definitions.explanation: To defeat an opponent in a game, competition, or conflict.
To successfully overcome a challenge or difficulty.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}に{勝|か}てる{自信|じしん}がない。
examples.english: I don't have confidence that I can beat him.
examples.notes: に marks the opponent; {勝|か}てる is potential form

examples.japanese: {決勝|けっしょう}で{勝|か}って{優勝|ゆうしょう}した。
examples.english: I won the final and became champion.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pair: None (but related: {負|ま}ける = to lose). Pattern: Xに{勝|か}つ (win against X / win at X).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {勝|か}っている = 'is winning' (current lead) or 'has won.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{試合|しあい}に{勝|か}つ (win a game)
・{相手|あいて}に{勝|か}つ (beat an opponent)
・3{対|たい}2で{勝|か}つ (win 3 to 2)
・{誘惑|ゆうわく}に{勝|か}つ (overcome temptation)
・{勝|か}ち{負|ま}け (win or lose—noun)

OPPOSITE: {負|ま}ける (to lose)

IDIOMS:
・{勝|か}ちに{行|い}く (go for the win)
・{勝|か}ち{残|のこ}る (survive as winner)

REGISTER: Neutral.
